_comment: Human decisions about files in the publisher's image folder that the naming rule cannot place. assign: file -> printing and face, with the reason. ignore: files that must not be used, with the reason. Every entry is an audit trail, like data/overrides.json.

004-foot_soldiers-bt-s.png.reason: The folder pluralises the Arthurian Legends box-topper Foot Soldier (registry slug 004-foot_soldier-bt-s). Byte-identical (same MD5) to 004-foot_soldiers_english-bt-s.png, the English face, which the API models as the front.

004-foot_soldiers-bt-s-r.png.reason: Reverse of the above. Byte-identical to 004-foot_soldiers_saracen-bt-s.png, the Saracen face, which the API models as the back.

ignore.004-foot_soldiers_english-bt-s.png: Same bytes as 004-foot_soldiers-bt-s.png, which is used for P003076's front.
ignore.004-foot_soldiers_saracen-bt-s.png: Same bytes as 004-foot_soldiers-bt-s-r.png, which is used for P003076's back.
ignore.999-waypoint_portal-d-s.png: No such printing upstream: the API lists Waypoint Portal's Dust promo only as foil (999-waypoint_portal-d-f). Kept out until upstream lists a standard-finish printing; the registry does not invent printings from image files.
